generation.prompt_exact:
Create a production sprite sheet for ChirpNeighbors: EXACTLY FOUR distinct isolated placeable backyard objects in a strict 2 by 2 grid on a fully transparent alpha background, each entire object and its small contact shadow inside its own quadrant, with generous clear gutters and margins. No labels, text, numbers, panel borders, swatches, scenery, birds or plants. All four are detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART with visibly crisp square pixel clusters, restrained rich texture and soft earthy shading, subtle dark contour, consistent three-quarter side garden view with slight top visibility, warm upper-left sunlight. Not cartoon/chibi, no glossy vector surfaces, no photorealism, no UI. Calm handcrafted realism where birds can remain focus.
TOP LEFT: large empty terracotta plant pot with broad thick rolled rim, tapered round body, warm burnt-orange clay with worn pale mineral texture, dark empty hollow interior, small stable base. No saucer, no plants, no dirt pile.
TOP RIGHT: low rectangular raised cedar planter box on four short stout legs, wide accessible open box filled with gently uneven dark brown bare soil, thick wood boards, simple practical joinery, a little weathering, no plants or tools. Entire object visible.
BOTTOM LEFT: dark muted olive-green rain barrel, squat cylindrical ribbed plastic body on a simple low wooden block base, closed secure flat lid, small brass spigot low on the visible front side, subtle wear, clean restrained silhouette. No downspout or hose connection extending outside object, no logo.
BOTTOM RIGHT: freestanding dark metal garden hose reel on a compact two-foot frame, neatly wound muted forest-green hose, short brass nozzle resting in side clip, little crank handle, clear structural feet. No dangling or uncoiled hose, no wheels, no extra objects.
Four individual objects only; no added decorations. Match coherent realistic relative material scale but give each quadrant a useful large sprite. Transparent outside silhouettes; no white/checkerboard backdrop. These are flattened still candidates, not an animation.
